== PC Discord and Retro Club facts added, 24 November 2026 ==
Added the date of the Final Confrontation between the two group winners, 7 May 2022 (Solidsnack3 in #cantina, SWCCG Players Committee Discord (7 May 2022), [https://discord.com/channels/401469156907679746/401469157587025922/972499419981312041 Discord message]).
=== Possibly faulty data ===
* A Discord post of 29 April 2022, the day before the event, says "there are over 70 players playing in two separate groupings" (Solidsnack3 in #cantina, SWCCG Players Committee Discord (29 April 2022), [https://discord.com/channels/401469156907679746/401469157587025922/969720738615533568 Discord message]). The Players Committee wrap-up says the 30 April competition "included 51 players in across two groups". The Discord figure was not added; the wrap-up count is the published one.
